answer: To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond in a shared vault before voting, with withdrawals delayed one epoch. Adversaries splitting into many identities must lock capital per reputation slot, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds held illiquid. Honest peers on the mesa verify stake proofs, and any agent caught double-claiming is exiled to a quarantined island where its stake is slashed, making mass impersonation economically self-defeating.
